बॉलीवुड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर! 🔥
नेशनल अवॉर्ड जीतने वाले डायरेक्टर आनंद एल राय और स्टार धनुष चौथी बार एक साथ आ रहे हैं। 🎬
इनकी अगली फिल्म एक रोमांटिक पीरियड एक्शन ड्रामा होगी, जो एक बड़े पैमाने का सिनेमैटिक स्पेक्टकल है। ⚔️
इस फिल्म की शूटिंग साल 2027 के बीच में शुरू होने की उम्मीद है। 📅
बड़े-बड़े स्टंट सीन्स के लिए इंटरनेशनल लेवल पर मशहूर जर्मन एक्शन डायरेक्टर Stefan Richter को ऑन-बोर्ड किया गया है। 🌟
इससे पहले ये जोड़ी Raanjhanaa, Atrangi Re और Tere Ishk Mein जैसी फिल्मों में साथ काम कर चुकी है। 🍿
आपको धनुष और आनंद एल राय की जोड़ी कैसी लगती है? नीचे कमेंट करके बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Makers of Aanand L Rai and Dhanush’s next romantic period action drama on-board internationally acclaimed Stefan Richter as action director; to begin filming in 2027
ctx.summary: National Award winners, Aanand L Rai and Dhanush are teaming up for their fourth film together, following collaborations like Raanjhanaa, Atrangi Re and Tere Ishk Mein. Their next is a romantic period action drama, that is aimed to be an ambitious cinematic spectacle where two hearts find each other amid fights and large scale stunt sequences in a bygone era. This is a genre that puts Aanand L Rai and Dhanush in unchartered waters as neither has attempted this together before. Taking charge of the larger-than-life action sequences will be the internationally acclaimed German action director Stefan Richter, whose work includes Don 2, Kick, Uri: The Surgical Strike, Saaho and Shivaay. Stefan is also helming yet another Colour Yellow project, Ajay Devgn's much awaited action thriller Chauhaan. Filming for the period drama is expected to begin from mid-2027. After three films built on tender, character driven emotion, Aanand L Rai and Dhanush are carrying that feeling into a bigger world, where love has to survive battles as well as heartbreak. Rai and Dhanush’s last outing Tere Ishk Mein, which released last year, also starred Kriti Sanon in a pivotal role. The movie achieved success at the box office and it also gave rise to a lot of conversations. ctx.text:
The director-actor duo's last film Tere Ishk Mein released last year.
National Award winners, Aanand L Rai and Dhanush are teaming up for their fourth film together, following collaborations like Raanjhanaa , Atrangi Re and Tere Ishk Mein . Their next is a romantic period action drama, that is aimed to be an ambitious cinematic spectacle where two hearts find each other amid fights and large scale stunt sequences in a bygone era. This is a genre that puts Aanand L Rai and Dhanush in unchartered waters as neither has attempted this together before.
Taking charge of the larger-than-life action sequences will be the internationally acclaimed German action director Stefan Richter, whose work includes Don 2 , Kick , Uri: The Surgical Strike , Saaho and Shivaay . Stefan is also helming yet another Colour Yellow project, Ajay Devgn's much awaited action thriller Chauhaan .
Filming for the period drama is expected to begin from mid-2027. After three films built on tender, character driven emotion, Aanand L Rai and Dhanush are carrying that feeling into a bigger world, where love has to survive battles as well as heartbreak.
Rai and Dhanush’s last outing Tere Ishk Mein , which released last year, also starred Kriti Sanon in a pivotal role. The movie achieved success at the box office and it also gave rise to a lot of conversations.
